title: Material
description: A substance canon can name, carry and make something out of. The layer that was missing: canon could say a leviathan swims and that a harpoon exists, and had no way to say the second is made from the first. A material answers what stuff *is* and where it comes from; it never answers how much of it there is, which is a question about a particular player and belongs to the game.

classes.description: What kind of stuff this is, from database/material_classes.json. A list because the interesting materials are genuinely two things at once -- mahua seed is `oil` and `produce`, and a recipe asking for either should find it. Pinned against that file by lint_story.py in both directions, so the vocabulary and this enum cannot drift.

won_from.description: The `flora_`, `fauna_` or `place_` entities this is taken from. Resolved by the reference walker rather than here. Absent is legal and common -- canon knows salt-crust is salt without owing anyone an account of which pan it was scraped from.

found_in.description: Biomes the material can be gathered in, from database/biomes.json. Wider than the game's renderable set on purpose, exactly as `biomes` is on a species -- canon may put a thing in the open sky and let the export drop it.

rarity.description: How often a gatherer meets it. Same three values as a species carries, and for the same reason: the game weights pools with it, so a fourth value silently changes what a player finds.

worked_by.description: `process_` ids that can transform this. Optional and one-directional by design -- a recipe names its own process, and this is a convenience for the atlas rather than a second source of truth.

epochs.description: Epoch ids from database/timeline/epochs.json. Absent means present in all epochs, which is right for most stuff -- clay does not belong to an era.

source_index.description: Position in the authored sequence. Materials are not indexed into per-biome pools the way species are, so this is presentation rather than a seed contract -- but the exporter sorts every folder the same way and an unindexed entity sorts last.

canon.description: How firmly this is established. Most materials are `inferred`: canon's sources describe a world in which people plainly have rope, and rarely stop to say so.
